title: Public blueberry trait claims are not yet comparable enough to support confident programme-level performance rankings
rationale: Planasa publishes conflicting soluble-solids figures for Blue Manila without a common method, Costa publishes shelf-life claims without a disclosed protocol, and the one method-stating independent trial in this package covers different varieties and conditions. These records support a provenance warning: owner figures and independent measurements should not be placed on a common performance scale without comparable protocols. They do not establish that the owner claims are false or that the programmes perform poorly; direct, matched testing could change this view.
why_it_matters: Programme rankings built from unmatched public claims would create false precision in testing and commercial decisions.
would_change_our_view: Comparable independent or internal measurements reproducing the published figures under disclosed protocols.
